cohort: 14,708 pregnant women who delivered at Minhang Hospital affiliated to Fudan University, Shanghai, China from January 1, 2013, to June 30, 2020
finding: Women with NAFLD, even those with normal pre-pregnancy weight, have a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, cesarean section, preterm birth, and macrosomia.
mod_finding: NAFLD was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section.
